tree.heading: Reckless Endangerment.—
tree.text: Any person subject to this chapter who engages in conduct that— shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

children.text: is wrongful and reckless or is wanton; and
is likely to produce death or grievous bodily harm to another person;

tree.heading: Dueling.—
tree.text: Any person subject to this chapter— shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

children.text: who fights or promotes, or is concerned in or connives at fighting, a duel; or
who, having knowledge of a challenge sent or about to be sent, fails to report the facts promptly to the proper authority;

tree.heading: Firearm Discharge, Endangering Human Life.—
tree.text: Any person subject to this chapter who, willfully and wrongly, discharges a firearm, under circumstances such as to endanger human life shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

tree.heading: Carrying Concealed Weapon.—
tree.text: Any person subject to this chapter who unlawfully carries a dangerous weapon concealed on or about his person shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

Amendments2016—Pub. L. 114–328 amended section generally. Prior to amendment, text read as follows: “Any person subject to this chapter who fights or promotes, or is concerned in or connives at fighting a duel, or who, having knowledge of a challenge sent or about to be sent, fails to report the facts promptly to the proper authority, shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.”
